title: Tasks — acceptance checklist
note: BASELINE created 2026-07-29. Until now this module had NO acceptance list, so "completely built" had no definition and no honest percentage could be shown. Every item starts OPEN because none has been verified — this is a scope statement, not a claim of failure. M grows when new surfaces or defects appear (Rule 21).

items.title: Surface /tasks renders real entity-scoped data with no dead end
items.evidence: Route /tasks registered as ProtectedRoute wrapping TaskBoardPage; TaskBoardPage now guards missing operating company with honest empty state; page renders TasksModuleTabs and TaskPlannerGrid; TaskPlannerGrid fetches /api/v1/tasks/planner via fetchPlannerTasks with operating_company_id, date_from, date_to; query errors now surface ListErrorBanner with retry; loading and honest empty states present; + Create Task button wired to CreateTaskModal with operatingCompanyId.

items.title: Surface /tasks/calendar renders real entity-scoped data with no dead end
items.evidence: Route /tasks/calendar registered as ProtectedRoute wrapping TasksCalendarPage; page now guards missing operating company with honest empty state; fetches /api/v1/tasks/planner via fetchPlannerTasks with operating_company_id, date_from, date_to for visible month; query errors now surface ListErrorBanner with retry; month navigation and today buttons wired; calendar grid renders entity-scoped tasks by day with honest empty cells.

items.title: Surface /tasks/chat renders real entity-scoped data with no dead end
items.evidence: Route /tasks/chat registered as ProtectedRoute wrapping TasksChatPage; page now guards missing operating company with honest empty state; fetches /api/v1/tasks/planner via fetchPlannerTasks with operating_company_id, date_from, date_to for task picker; task-picker and comment-thread query errors now surface ListErrorBanner with retry; task selector updates URL search param; composer supports @mention using assignable users; createTaskComment posts to active task.

items.title: Surface /tasks/mine renders real entity-scoped data with no dead end
items.evidence: Route /tasks/mine registered as ProtectedRoute wrapping TasksMinePage; page now guards missing operating company with honest empty state; fetches current user via getMe and /api/v1/tasks/planner via fetchPlannerTasks with operating_company_id, assigned_to=currentUser, date_from, date_to; query errors now surface ListErrorBanner with retry; ParityTable renders assigned tasks with open/overdue/completed summary cards and honest empty text.

items.title: Surface /tasks/report renders real entity-scoped data with no dead end
items.evidence: Route /tasks/report registered as ProtectedRoute wrapping TasksReportPage; page now guards missing operating company with honest empty state; fetches /api/v1/tasks/planner via fetchPlannerTasks with operating_company_id, date_from, date_to for selected window; query errors now surface ListErrorBanner with retry; window selector buttons (7d/30d/90d) wired; summary cards and by-assignee ParityTable aggregate entity-scoped tasks with honest empty text.
